name: PostHog Product Analytics Suite
description: Self-hosted product analytics, session replay, feature flags and A/B tests.

PORT.description: Caddy listen port (public domain target).

web.preDeployCommand: /bin/bash -c 'for hp in $MIGRATE_WAIT_FOR; do until (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/${hp%:*}/${hp##*:}) 2>/dev/null; do echo "waiting for $hp"; sleep 5; done; done; exec ./bin/migrate'

PORT.description: Granian HTTP port; Railway healthcheck probes it.

GRANIAN_WORKERS.description: Web worker processes (~1.1 GB RAM each). Upstream default is 4; raise it for more concurrent API/UI requests.

SITE_URL.description: Public URL of PostHog (the proxy domain). Change it when you add a custom domain to the proxy.

SECRET_KEY.description: Django secret key (hobby installer format). Generated once; changing it logs everyone out.

ENCRYPTION_SALT_KEYS.description: Salt for encrypted fields. Generated once; never change after first deploy.

INTERNAL_API_SECRET.description: Shared secret for internal calls (web/worker to recording-api, cymbal).

INTERNAL_REQUEST_TOKEN.description: Token for Django to feature-flags calls (flag test evaluation).

PERSONS_DB_WRITER_URL.description: Persons database (same Postgres database in the hobby layout).

REDIS_URL.description: Redis for cache, Celery broker and locks.

CLICKHOUSE_SECURE.description: Plain TCP inside the private network.

CLICKHOUSE_VERIFY.description: No TLS verification (no TLS on the private network).

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse admin user used for queries and migrations.

CLICKHOUSE_DICT_READER_USER.description: Read-only user ClickHouse dictionaries authenticate as.

CLICKHOUSE_LOGS_CLUSTER_HOST.description: ClickHouse host for the logs product (same server; upstream default is localhost).

CLICKHOUSE_LOGS_CLUSTER_SECURE.description: Plain TCP for the logs cluster connection.

CLICKHOUSE_LOGS_CLUSTER_PASSWORD.description: Password for the logs cluster connection (default user).

DEPLOYMENT.description: Deployment type; hobby keeps persons in the main database and runs persons migrations.

IS_BEHIND_PROXY.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* from the Caddy proxy / Railway edge.

DISABLE_SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT.description: TLS is terminated by Railway; avoids a redirect loop.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: Service name if OpenTelemetry is enabled later.

API_QUERIES_PER_TEAM.description: Concurrent API query limit per team (upstream hobby value).

CDP_API_URL.description: Internal URL of the plugins (CDP) service.

OBJECT_STORAGE_ENABLED.description: Use S3 object storage for exports and media.

OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT.description: SeaweedFS S3 endpoint for exports, media and AI blobs (private network).

OBJECT_STORAGE_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT.description: Base URL for presigned downloads; the proxy forwards /posthog/* to objectstorage.

SESSION_RECORDING_V2_S3_ENDPOINT.description: SeaweedFS S3 endpoint for session recordings.

RECORDING_API_URL.description: Internal URL of the recording API (replay playback).

PERSONHOG_ADDR.description: gRPC address of the personhog router.

PERSONHOG_ENABLED.description: Read persons through personhog, as the upstream hobby stack does.

FEATURE_FLAGS_SERVICE_URL.description: Internal URL of the Rust feature-flags service.

TEMPORAL_HOST.description: Temporal frontend host (batch exports, data warehouse, workflows).

LIVESTREAM_HOST.description: Public URL of the live events stream (proxied to livestream).

OPT_OUT_CAPTURE.description: Anonymous usage reporting to PostHog Inc. (upstream default). Set true to opt out.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional: Anthropic API key to enable PostHog AI. Leave empty to keep AI features off.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional: OpenAI API key for SQL and regex assist.

OPENAI_MODEL.description: Model used for OpenAI-backed assists (upstream default).

MIGRATE_WAIT_FOR.description: host:port list the pre-deploy step waits for before running migrations.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Let in-flight requests finish on redeploy.
